steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat butter and sugar with the paddle on medium for 3 minutes. Add the egg and vanilla.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.text: Mix flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt, then add on low until a soft dough forms.

steps.title: Roll in cinnamon sugar
steps.text: Roll 40 g balls in the cinnamon and sugar and place them on a lined tray, spaced apart.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the edges are set and the centers look slightly underdone.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Cream butter and sugar with the paddle for 2 minutes. Add the egg and vanilla, then the flour, baking powder and salt on low until it comes together.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Divide into two discs, wrap, and chill until firm.

steps.title: Roll and cut
steps.text: Roll to 5 mm on a floured counter, cut shapes, and place on a lined tray. Chill the cut cookies for 10 minutes so they keep their shape.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the edges are just turning golden. Cool completely before icing.

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.text: Mix crust ingredients with the paddle on low until crumbly. Press firmly into a lined 20 cm square pan.

steps.title: Bake the crust
steps.text: Bake until lightly golden at the edges.

steps.title: Whisk the filling
steps.text: Whisk sugar, eggs, flour, juice and zest until smooth. Pour over the warm crust.

steps.title: Bake and cool
steps.text: Bake until the center is just set. Cool completely, chill, and dust with powdered sugar before cutting.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add eggs and vanilla and mix on low until a sticky dough forms, then fold in the almonds.

steps.title: Shape the log
steps.text: With wet hands, shape into a flat log about 30 cm long and 8 cm wide on a lined tray.

steps.title: First bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and firm. Cool for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Slice and bake again
steps.text: Slice into 1.5 cm pieces with a serrated knife, lay them flat, and bake until dry and crisp, flipping once.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat butter and brown sugar with the paddle for 2 minutes. Add molasses and egg and mix until smooth.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Add flour, baking soda, spices and salt and mix on low until combined.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the dough until firm enough to roll.

steps.title: Roll and bake
steps.text: Roll into 35 g balls, coat in sugar, and place on a lined tray. Bake until the tops crack and the edges set.

ingredients.name: chocolate chips or white chocolate chunks

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk melted butter and brown sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla until glossy.

steps.title: Fold in the dry ingredients
steps.text: Fold in flour, baking powder and salt just until combined, then fold in the chocolate.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread into a lined 20 cm square pan. Bake until the edges are set and the center is slightly soft. Cool before cutting.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat butter, tahini and both sugars with the paddle for 3 minutes, then add the egg.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Add flour, baking soda and salt on low, then mix in the chocolate.

steps.title: Scoop and bake
steps.text: Scoop 40 g balls, roll the tops in sesame seeds, and bake until the edges are golden.
